title: Virtual bucket
description: The .ebrains/bucket.json file of a virtual bucket: which bucket the folder stands for, and when it was last listed.

format_version.description: Version of the layout of the .ebrains folder. An implementation refuses a version greater than the one it knows.

prefix.description: Folder of the bucket that the virtual bucket stands for: "" for the whole bucket, or a folder name with a trailing "/", no leading "/", no empty, "." or ".." folder or backslash, and no Windows drive such as "C:" as its first folder.

listed_at.description: When the manifest was last made from a listing, in UTC, or null if it never was.
